meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后,你提出改动需求时,Claude 会先提问弄清你想改什么,再按对应流程帮你给 NanoClaw 添加新渠道、接入 MCP 集成、改触发规则、路由或部署,并告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加渠道(如 Telegram、Slack 等)、接入集成、改触发规则、改路由或做其他定制时触发;它会先提问确认需求。

say.text: 把 Telegram 加成一个输入渠道
say.note: 会先问你接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加一个 Gmail MCP 工具
say.note: 走对应的 add-gmail-tool 流程

say.text: 改一下这条 wiring 的触发规则
say.note: 用 ncl wirings update 修改

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask for a change Claude first asks clarifying questions, then follows the matching flow to add channels, wire MCP integrations, change triggers, routing, or deployment for NanoClaw, and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), add an integration, change triggers, routing, or make other NanoClaw customizations; it asks questions to understand the request first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group

say_en.text: Add a Gmail MCP tool to this agent group
Change the trigger rules on this wiring
say_en.note: Updates them via ncl wirings update
